sections.A: Stroke dimagh ke kisi hisse mein khoon ki supply rukne se achanak kaam band hona hai: blockage (ischaemic) ya khoon behna (haemorrhagic).
sections.B: BE-FAST se pehchanein: Balance, Eyes, Face (chehra latakna), Arm (baazu ki kamzori), Speech (bolne mein masla), Time (foran emergency).
sections.C: Stroke ki qism, kab hua, kaun si taraf, kya ilaaj hua, aur stroke se pehle patient kya kar sakta tha.
sections.D: Activity se pehle aur baad BP, hosh aur yaad-dasht, tone, taaqat, sensation, balance aur chaal.
sections.E: Modified Ashworth (spasticity), Berg balance, gait speed, Fugl-Meyer aur Barthel jaise standard measures.
sections.F: Rehab ke dauraan naya stroke ya TIA, sugar kam hona aur doosri wajahein table mein hain.
sections.G: Naya chehre, baazu ya bolne ka masla, ya achanak nazar ya balance ka nuqsan: emergency. BP bohat zyada ho to activity rokein.
sections.H: Medically stable hai? Nahi to positioning aur halka kaam. Haan to dheere dheere mobilisation aur task practice.
sections.I: Facilitated movement se patient ko sahi movement mehsoos karwana, lekin asal zor patient ki apni practice par.
sections.J: Task-specific, baar baar, dheere dheere mushkil aur patient ke liye ahem kaam ki practice: chalna, baazu ka istemal, balance.
sections.K: Foot drop ya kandhe ke liye FES kuch patients mein madadgar.
sections.L: Pehle din: stability, positioning, nigalne ki ehtiyat, jaldi mobilisation. Phir intensive rehab, ghar par wapsi aur community.
sections.M: Gait speed, 6MWT, Berg, Fugl-Meyer, Ashworth, Barthel aur goals dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 64 saal ke aadmi ko 10 din pehle left MCA stroke hua. Khud socho kya plan karna hai, phir jawab dekho.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
